text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Shift +0.50 of capacity for 15 days, ending on day 14 (dashed rule, top panel). Black: shifted target (the series the forecast is scored against). Dashed purple: observed power. Bands: q05 to q95. Lines: medians. Leave-one-month-out, mean over five seeds. H1 keeps carrying part of the shift for about 3 days after the shift ends, which the target no longer contains.'
text.tspan: Shift +0.50 of capacity for 15 days, ending on day 14 (dashed rule, top panel).
Black: shifted target (the series the forecast is scored against). Dashed purple: observed power.
Bands: q05 to q95. Lines: medians. Leave-one-month-out, mean over five seeds.
H1 keeps carrying part of the shift for about 3 days after the shift ends, which the target no longer contains.
